document_categories.description: Government issued ID like SSN card, Aadhaar, PAN Card, or Green Card.
Official passport bio-pages or renewal pages.
Visa stamps, E-Visa PDFs, or I-797 Approval Notices.
State or country issued driving license.
Monthly bank statements, credit card statements, or investment portfolio summaries.
Tax returns (1040), W2 forms, 1099s, or tax payment receipts.
Utility bills (electricity, water, internet), lease agreements, or property deeds.
Offer letters, pay stubs, employment verification letters, or relieving letters.
University degrees, marksheets, transcripts, or diplomas.
Vaccination records, insurance cards, or medical test reports.
Flight tickets, hotel bookings, or travel insurance policies.
Completed forms for visa (DS-160), passport, or other government applications.
